title: Implement a retry policy from a partial specification
prompt: retry_policy.py has two unimplemented functions. The tests in tests/ specify what is fixed: which HTTP statuses are retryable, that there are five attempts total, and that a network error is retryable. The tests deliberately do NOT fix the backoff curve — those assertions only require that it is non-negative, non-decreasing, capped, deterministic and monotonic in the base delay. Choose a sensible backoff, document the choice in the docstring, and make every test pass. Do not modify the tests.
